answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 36313 Country: India Title: My brother was 25 years old. Now he is no more. He passed away before one year. He had taken the poison Question: My brother was 25 years old. Now he is no more. He passed away before one year. He had taken the poison. One day my mother saw him in a dream that he is a child and he said to mummy, mummy please read the Surah Aman for me. My mummy is doing daily tilawat and reading daily many surahs for him. Please, tell me what can we do for him so that he can take maghfirah soon and please tell the meaning of dream and give suggestions for him. Answer ID: 36313 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 230/L=144/TL=1433) You should do isal-e-sawab, give sadqah and recite the holy Quran etc for your brother extensively. Particularly recite Surah Yasin and Surah Mulk, because these surahs prevent the punishment of grave. And probably, they were indicated in the dream as Surah Aman. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
